segments.title: Yokosuka Peace Park, Mikasa, and ships in the harbour
segments.body: Yokosuka Peace Park sits above the Yokosuka City Museum and overlooks the waterfront. The museum is larger than its modest name suggests: three official floors plus a couple of mezzanines make it feel closer to four. An offshore island helps the group locate Mikasa, although the identification of her mast remains tentative. They then use the view to work out where their hotel lies. A distant, boxy ship under way prompts a joking debate over whether it is a car carrier or HMAS Canberra. The exchange leaves its identity unresolved, and the comments about the Canberra class concern its appearance. A Hobart-class destroyer of the Royal Australian Navy is separately reported in dock.
